summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#669](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/669)** — Adds the first version of the ALFA detector concept (`ALFA_o1_v00`). It includes compact files, an outer tracker barrel, a Grainita ECAL barrel driver (`Grainita_ECAL_Barrel_v02`) with a dedicated SD action, a new `FCCSWGridRhoPhiTheta_k4geo` segmentation, a steering file and tests; it also modifies the `VertexBarrel_detailed_o1_v03` constructor.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#674](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/674)** — `ALLEGRO_o1_v04` now takes everything except its HCAL files from `ALLEGRO_o1_v03` via relative includes, so both versions share the same `DectDimensions` and silicon wrapper properties. This removes about 1900 lines of duplicated XML and avoids silent divergences between versions like the one reported in k4geo#673.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#413](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413)** — `OverlayTiming` gains a `RandomMixBackgroundFiles` option for beam-induced background produced as many single-event files. Each file in a group becomes an independent source, drawn from a shuffled permutation that is reshuffled when exhausted. This avoids overlaying only the first few files of a group, and the PR adds documentation and dedicated tests.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#33](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/33)** — Adds Pandora particle-flow algorithms for the IDEA option 2 detector: ECAL-seeded HCAL clustering, dual-readout correction, PFO creation and isolated-hit preparation. Two ONNX-based ML algorithms (photon ID and satellite-cluster merging) build only with `LCContent_BUILD_ML=ON`. PandoraSDK ≥ 04.00.01 is required.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#402](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/402)** — ALLEGRO digi/reco steering adds a `siDigitizer` option to choose the new `VTXdigitizerDetailed` instead of DDPlanarDigi for silicon detectors. Sensor pitches are now read directly from the compact files, while DDPlanarDigi effective resolutions can still be overridden. Threshold and smearing settings for the detailed digitiser still need tuning.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/113)** — `TrackMerger` gains track-parameter significance as a matching criterion and uses it by default. Matching defaults are aligned with `ClonesAndSplitTracksFinder` in CLDConfig, which changes merging behaviour for existing configurations.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#241](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/241)** — Nightly reconstruction benchmarks now cover every detector except SiD (ALLEGRO o1_v04/o2_v01, CLD o2_v09/o3_v01, IDEA o1_v04/o2_v01, ILD_FCCee v01/v02) on Zbb and single-electron samples. A `data_files` mechanism provides the required inputs.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#245](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/245)** — k4run benchmarks gain an untimed memory pass (`--memory-events`) in which an allocation counter attributes every heap block to its owning Gaudi component. The pass writes per-event, per-component heap snapshots, which are the basis for the new reco Memory dashboard views.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#252](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/252)** — Adds a Correlations dashboard section that relates per-event time and memory costs to event content (generator particles, collection sizes, energies). It offers a clickable Spearman matrix and user-typed per-event expressions.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#265](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/265)** — The reconstruction dashboard page is regrouped into Time, Memory, Components, Data Flow and Events sections. A new Components section inspects any algorithm or service and replaces the former Efficiency tab, while aliases keep old section links working.

- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events#23](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events/pull/23)** — DaMI replaces its authenticated/unauthenticated gate with viewer, editor and admin roles. Editors are granted in-app and admins come from CERN roles/e-groups; admin-only user-management endpoints and a matching UI are added.

- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events#30](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events/pull/30)** — Datasets created through the DaMI single-record form now require a DRS request reference (`DRS-<n>`), validated server-side. Creating new navigation values such as accelerator or campaign is restricted to admins.
